text: Ifeoma's mum is having her knee replaced on November 12th. Ifeoma is staying with her for the first week afterwards, and her brother Tunde takes over after that. She's worried her mum won't do the exercises properly. Remind me to text Ifeoma on the 13th to see how the operation went.
Coffee with Bruno. His daughter Lila starts reception next Tuesday and he's more nervous than she is. Remind me to ask him how drop-off went.

Gemma and Damian got engaged in Lisbon over the weekend! He proposed at a tiny restaurant by the river. She's already talking about a spring wedding, maybe April 25th if the venue near her parents is free. Damian's mum has offered to make the cake, which Gemma is slightly nervous about. They're having a small engagement drinks thing next Friday.
Need to renew my passport before the end of the month and book the dentist for Friday.

Rahul had his gallbladder out yesterday. He sounded groggy on the phone but said the nurses have been lovely. He hopes to be home by Thursday, but it depends on whether they're happy with his bloods. His wife is popping in every day and their son is driving down from Leeds this weekend to help out at home. He also said he's finally going to read the books I gave him.
Siobhan's son Alfie graduates from Edinburgh on July 2nd. She's flying up the day before with her sister.
Don't forget to send Farah a card for her and Tunde's tenth anniversary. It's 6/18.
Talked to Kalani after yoga. She's been vegetarian for years and recently got really into sourdough. Her partner Joe is a firefighter.
Asha's driving test is this Friday at 9am. It's her third attempt and she's really anxious about the roundabouts. I should text her good luck on Thursday night.
Mateo's wedding is off. He and Rin split up a couple of weeks ago, and he's taking it hard. Must check in with him this weekend.
Irina mentioned her dad has a cardiology appointment on March 4. They're hoping it's nothing serious.

Dinner with Yosef and his wife. Their twins start secondary school in September and they're touring schools every Saturday until then. He also said he's training for a half marathon in March and has joined a running club that meets on Sunday mornings. His wife thinks he's mad. I should send him that training plan I used.
Remind me to ask Siddharth how his MRI went on Monday.
Jess just told me she's been accepted onto the nursing course at Leeds. She starts in a fortnight and is moving into halls the weekend before.
Zoe's grandad is in hospital with pneumonia. She's been visiting every evening after work and seems exhausted. I should drop round some food tomorrow.
Santiago turns 40 on May 14. His wife Farah is planning a surprise dinner on the 16th, so don't mention anything to him.
Fiona said her little boy, Sam, lost his first tooth today and is convinced the tooth fairy is coming tonight.
Alejandro is recovering well from his shoulder surgery. Physio twice a week for the next six weeks, and he can't drive until the end of January.
I'm taking Esme to her hospital appointment on Wednesday morning. Need to leave by 8 to get parking.

Esme has a hip replacement booked for December 3rd. She's been in pain for months, so honestly she's relieved. Her daughter Laila is taking time off to help, and the grandkids are coming over on Sundays. Esme said she wants to be walking properly by the time of her granddaughter's wedding in the spring. I should drop off some books and a puzzle before she goes in.
Kiri and Anders are celebrating their silver wedding anniversary next Saturday with a party at the cricket club. They asked me to bring a dessert.
Dimitri's son passed his GCSEs with flying colours. Dimitri was beaming the whole time we talked.
Remind me to call Farid on Sunday. His operation was moved again and he sounded fed up.
Laila's engagement party is on 8/22. I said I'd help with decorations the morning of.
Quick chat with Tunde at the school gate. His daughter has her ballet exam next Thursday and has been practising every night. He said she's quite nervous.
Gemma mentioned Damian loves vintage watches, and he keeps looking at a particular Seiko. Could be a good idea for a wedding present.
Joe is out of hospital! He was in for four nights after the appendix scare. He's back at his mum's to recover until next week.
Need to pick up a graduation card for Alfie and get it in the post by Wednesday.
Ran into Mrs Morris at the pharmacy. Her husband is having cataract surgery next month, and she's worried about getting him there and back since she doesn't drive.
Siddharth and his partner Rin are expecting their first baby in April. He told me after the meeting, and he couldn't stop smiling.
Yosef's daughter got into Oxford to study medicine. Remind me to send him a congratulations message tonight.
Uncle Bruno's colonoscopy results came back clear. Mum is so relieved.

Long call with Irina. Her brother Dimitri is getting married in Crete on June 3rd, and the whole family is flying out on the 29th of May. She's giving a speech because his fiancée's sister can't travel, and she's been stressing about it. She also said her son starts school in September and she's dreading the uniform shopping. I must send her my old speech notes this week.
Kalani's cat Pepper had surgery on her paw on Tuesday. She's home now in a cone and very grumpy, apparently.
Farah is allergic to shellfish and can't stand spicy food. Worth remembering for the anniversary dinner.
Got the car serviced today. Must remember to book the MOT for next spring.
Asha passed her driving test! Want to take her out for a celebratory drink this weekend.
Santiago's mum is in for a hip operation on Monday and he's taking the week off to be with her. He looked worn out. Remind me to message him on Tuesday to see how she's doing.

Lunch with Siobhan Kaur. She's just been promoted to head of year at the primary school and starts the new role after the Easter holidays. She's also learning Italian for a trip to Rome in the summer.
Bruno and Lila are renewing their vows on their 20th anniversary, October 9th. Small ceremony, family only.

Fiona's mother-in-law had a fall last week and broke her wrist. Fiona is doing most of the caring, plus juggling the kids and work. She admitted she's struggling a bit. Her husband is away on a work trip until the 20th, so it's all on her. I should offer to have the kids next Saturday, and maybe batch cook something for them on Sunday.
Alejandro proposed to Jess on her birthday, February 11th. They're thinking about a summer wedding next year in Spain.
Mateo's nephew starts nursery on Monday. Mateo is doing the pick-ups on Wednesdays.

Talked to Rahul about his son's A-level results. He got the grades he needed for Manchester and starts there on September 21st. Rahul and his wife are driving him up that weekend with the whole car packed. He admitted he's dreading the empty house, and his wife has already started planning to turn the bedroom into an office.
Need to buy a new kettle and sort out the gutter before the weekend.
Zoe says Kiri has been obsessed with birdwatching since she retired. She's planning a trip to the Norfolk coast in May.
Remind me to ask Gemma whether Damian's knee scan on Friday showed anything.
Dr Santos said Tunde's recovery is ahead of schedule. He's walking without the crutches now and is hoping to be back at work by November 1st.
Ifeoma and her husband Anders are celebrating 5 years married on 9/30. She hinted that he's been wanting a decent record player, so maybe we can all chip in.
Esme's granddaughter graduates from nursing school tomorrow. She's so proud she nearly cried telling me.
Joe mentioned his dog Rolo has to go to the vet for a dental on Thursday. He's a bit worried because Rolo is quite old now.
Laila had her wisdom teeth out this morning. Her face is very swollen. Don't forget to check on her tomorrow afternoon.
Farid's daughter Asha got her first proper job at an architecture firm. She starts on the 14th, and he's thrilled.
Yosef said the anniversary trip to Paris is cancelled because his wife's dad is unwell. They're staying home and visiting her parents instead.
Dimitri is a primary school teacher and lives near the park with his partner and two kids.
Sam and Zoe's son had his first swimming lesson last Saturday and loved it. Zoe says he's already asking when the next one is.
Anders has his hernia operation on Thursday 7th. He's taking two weeks off. I'm feeding his fish while he's in hospital.

Kalani said her wedding to Santiago has been pushed back from June 10th to next spring, mostly because of her dad's chemo schedule. She seemed calmer about it than I expected. Remind me to ask her next week how her dad is getting on with the treatment.
Irina's daughter has her piano recital at the end of term. Should get her some flowers for after.
Picked up the prescription and booked my flu jab for next Tuesday afternoon.
